custom_instruments types

CustomInstrumentTypes

Possible types of a custom instrument.

Name Value Description
CustomInstrumentTypes.Basket 'basket'
CustomInstrumentTypes.Formula 'formula'
CustomInstrumentTypes.UDC 'udc'

DayBasedRolloverMethod

Methods that determine when a day-based rollover to the next contract occurs.

Name Value Description
DayBasedRolloverMethod.DAYS_AFTER_BEGINNING_OF_MONTH 'daysAfterBeginningOfMonth' counts business days from the beginning of a specified month.
DayBasedRolloverMethod.DAYS_BEFORE_END_OF_MONTH 'daysBeforeEndOfMonth' counts back business days from the final business day of a specified month, the default is the expiry month of the first contract.
DayBasedRolloverMethod.DAYS_BEFORE_EXPIRY 'daysBeforeExpiry' the roll to the second contract occurs "X" business days before the expiry of the first contract.

Intervals

The list of interval types of the boundary is described below. The supported values of intervals : Time: Backend will return complete N-minute summaries data. When the request start and/or end does not at the N minutes boundary, the response will be adjusted. Days:

Name Value Description
Intervals.DAILY 'P1D' This is end of day, daily data
Intervals.FIVE_MINUTES 'PT5M' return complete 5-minutes
Intervals.HOURLY 'PT1H' return complete 1-hour
Intervals.MINUTE 'PT1M' return complete 1-minute
Intervals.MONTHLY 'P1M' Monthly boundary based on calendar month
Intervals.ONE_DAY 'P7D' This is end of day, daily data
Intervals.ONE_HOUR 'PT1H' return complete 1-hour
Intervals.ONE_MINUTE 'PT1M' return complete 1-minute
Intervals.ONE_MONTH 'P1M' Monthly boundary based on calendar month
Intervals.ONE_WEEK 'P1W' Weekly boundary based on the exchange's week summarization definition
Intervals.ONE_YEAR 'P1Y' Yearly boundary based on calendar year
Intervals.QUARTERLY 'P3M' Quarterly boundary based on calendar quarter
Intervals.SEVEN_DAYS 'P7D' Weekly boundary based on the exchange's week summarization definition
Intervals.SIXTY_MINUTES 'PT60M' return complete 60-minutes
Intervals.TEN_MINUTES 'PT10M' return complete 10-minutes
Intervals.THIRTY_MINUTES 'PT30M' return complete 30-minutes
Intervals.THREE_MONTHS 'P3M' Quarterly boundary based on calendar quarter
Intervals.TWELVE_MONTHS 'P12M' Yearly boundary based on calendar year
Intervals.WEEKLY 'P1W' Weekly boundary based on the exchange's
Intervals.YEARLY 'P1Y' Yearly boundary based on calendar year

SpreadAdjustmentMethod

Methods for computing the basis gap used to adjust prices when joining contracts in a UDC. close-to-close, open-to-open, close-to-open, close-to-open-old-gap and close-to-open-new-gap.

Name Value Description
SpreadAdjustmentMethod.CLOSE_TO_CLOSE 'close-to-close'
SpreadAdjustmentMethod.CLOSE_TO_OPEN 'close-to-open'
SpreadAdjustmentMethod.CLOSE_TO_OPEN_NEW_GAP 'close-to-open-new-gap'
SpreadAdjustmentMethod.CLOSE_TO_OPEN_OLD_GAP 'close-to-open-old-gap'
SpreadAdjustmentMethod.OPEN_TO_OPEN 'open-to-open'

VolumeBasedRolloverMethod

Methods that determine when a volume-based rollover to the next contract occurs.

Name Value Description
VolumeBasedRolloverMethod.OPEN_INTEREST 'openInterest'
VolumeBasedRolloverMethod.VOLUME 'volume'
VolumeBasedRolloverMethod.VOLUME_AND_OPEN_INTEREST 'volumeAndOpenInterest'
VolumeBasedRolloverMethod.VOLUME_OR_OPEN_INTEREST 'volumeOrOpenInterest'
